decision: Deletion of lap time (1:15.478) as per Article 12.3.1.d of the FIA International Sporting Code and Art 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
event_name: Date 27 July 2019 Time 15:51 2019 GERMAN GRAND PRIX 25 - 28 July 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 88 did not use the track at all times, at turn 17.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Ch IV, Art 2c and Article 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Deletion of lap time (1:15.478) as per Article 12.3.1.d of the FIA International Sporting Code and Art 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards received the report and timing information from the Race Director. The car left the track during the qualifying session. This was reviewed in accordance with the Race Director's event notes, point 9 and the Stewards ordered the relevant lap time to be deleted.
rules_referenced: Article 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 88 Did Not Use The Track At All Times
